標題： International Affairs Office – Lecture Series on Retaining International Talent for Employment in Taiwan: How Green Chemistry Expands Green Collar Talent
日期： Tue, 29 Apr 2025 17:21:10 +0800
附檔： OIA-– Lecture Series on Retaining International Talent for Employment in Taiwan.png (1 MB)   
The Office of International Affairs is hosting the International Talent Retention and Employment Lecture Series. We are honored to invite Deputy Director Chien Hui-Chen from the Chemicals Administration, Ministry of Environment, to lead our faculty and students in gaining a deeper understanding of the current development of green chemistry in Taiwan. All faculty and students interested in the current status and future prospects of green chemistry in the workplace are warmly welcome to attend!

-  Date： Tuesday, May 6, 2025
- Time: 14:00 ~ 17:00
- Event Venue: Administration Building, Room 301
- Capacity: 50 participants (Registration is based on the Campus Activities Reservation System. Please ensure your registration is successful.)
Campus Activities Hours Provided. Please remember to register through the  Campus Activities Reservation System!

- Registration Link:
